title: Persatrix Organization Configuration (v0.4.0+)
description: Internal-only schema until v1.0; `$id` may break across v0.x bumps without notice. RFC 0012 §B: an organization is a named graph of personas — its topology, its roles with their authority ceilings, and its members with the `manages` edges between them. This schema checks the shape. `agents/org_validate.py` checks the graph rules, each with a message that names it: no loop in `manages`, one manager per member in a hierarchy, a scope on every matrix edge and none on a hierarchy edge, no `manages` in a flat organization, every member a persona in agents.yaml, and each persona in one organization. `make validate` runs both, and the Go loader (RFC 0012 PR 2) applies the same rules.

organizations.description: Every organization the deployment declares. Empty, as shipped, means no organization: the deployment behaves as v0.3.16 did.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, as an agent id.

topology.description: `hierarchy`: a tree, each member with at most one manager, who directs them on every matter. `flat`: peers, no `manages` edges, so no member directs another. `matrix`: a member may have several managers, each edge scoped to one dimension, and a manager directs only within it (RFC 0012 §B, §C).

role.description: A role and its ceiling. A `clearance` key is refused until RFC 0012 §G's membership check returns, since a ceiling that nothing enforces would read as a control (the PR plan's D-3).

authority.description: The highest channel authority level at which a holder's directives count (RFC 0012 §D, §G). Every role declares it: a flat organization still gives its roles different weight, which depth cannot express (open question 1).

agent_id.description: A persona from agents.yaml. In v0.4.0 a persona belongs to one organization (open question 4).

manages.description: The members this member manages: an agent id, or `{agent_id, scope}` for a matrix edge.

scope.description: A matrix dimension, such as `project` or `function`. `general` is kept for a directive that names no dimension (the PR plan's D-9).
